products.name: Cisco Webex AI
products.note: Meeting intelligence; real-time translation; noise removal; enterprise security

profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (ticker: CSCO, CIK: 0000858877) that describes itself as a leader in AI infrastructure, secure networking, and software solutions. Its site presents a broad portfolio spanning AI-optimized networking, purpose-built programmable silicon for hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers, and security embedded across network layers. The company also promotes autonomous network operations through policy-bound agents that execute workflows at machine speed, with human oversight of intent, policy, and risk.

On the AI product side, Cisco offers Cisco Webex AI, tracked in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category, with capabilities that include meeting intelligence, real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security. The company also describes Cisco IQ as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance to support professional services. Separately, the site highlights data center modernization aimed at supporting both traditional and AI workloads.

The held facts show no litigation or MCP server registrations on record for Cisco at this time.
